ideas.pitch: An offline-first, augmented reality campus navigation assistant built for Clemson students that highlights real-time building congestion and accessibility updates.
ideas.title: TigerTrail Campus Nav
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the local student experience heavily appeals to on-site judges and local universities sponsoring or judging at CUhackit.

ideas.pitch: A predictive arrival time and crowd density tracker for campus game-day transit routes utilizing live crowdsourced student check-ins and historical route data.
ideas.title: Clemson GameDay Smart Shuttle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute, highly relatable logistical problem unique to Clemson University's massive game-day infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision powered reagent and equipment scanner for Clemson research labs that automates safety compliance checks and low-stock alerts.
ideas.title: LabBench Inventory AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to university researchers and department heads who value practical administrative automation tools.

ideas.pitch: Peer-to-peer micro-study group matching protocol that connects students in the same difficult STEM courses based on real-time schedule overlap and current module progress.
ideas.title: StudySwarms Clemson
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student life friction points, making it instantly engaging and demo-friendly for a collegiate judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning dashboard for campus dining halls that predicts daily food surplus based on weather, academic calendar events, and menu types to reduce campus waste.
ideas.title: Clemson Dining Waste Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical data science applications combined with local sustainability initiatives that university administrators care about.
